title: Gift Ideas for Kids Who Love to Draw (Ages 3-9)
intro: Little artists are easy to shop for when you know what to look for: washable, easy to hold and ready to use right out of the box. Here are eight simple gift ideas for kids ages 3 to 9 who love to draw, colour and make things. We picked everyday items that parents commonly buy, and we added our own printable drawing book at the top for a quick, screen-free start.
how: We looked at what parents often choose for young artists: easy-to-use supplies, safe and washable options, and gifts that need no setup. We have not tested every product, so please read the details and reviews before you buy.

items.name: Magic Shapes Drawing Book for Kids Ages 3-9
items.blurb: Our own 55-page learn-to-draw book. Kids build animals from simple circles, ovals and triangles, step by step. Print as many copies as you need, or get the paperback.

items.name: Washable markers
items.blurb: Washable markers are a stress-free start for little artists. Look for fine and broad tips, and wash-off ink that comes off skin and most surfaces.

items.name: Chunky crayons
items.blurb: Thick crayons are easier for small hands to hold. A good pick for ages 3 to 5 who are just learning to control lines and shapes.

items.name: Large sketchbook
items.blurb: A big sketchbook gives room to draw and does not tear as easily. Spiral binding lets the pages lie flat.

items.name: Colored pencil set
items.search: colored pencils for kids set with sharpener
items.blurb: Great for older kids who want more detail. A set with a sharpener and a tin or case keeps everything together.

items.name: Reusable drawing board
items.blurb: Draw, erase and draw again. Reusable boards are handy for car rides, quiet time and travel.

items.name: Tabletop easel
items.blurb: A small easel turns drawing into a special activity. Many fold flat so they are easy to store.

items.name: Washable watercolor paint set
items.search: washable watercolor paint set for kids
items.blurb: A first paint set for creative play. Washable paints and a few good brushes are all you need to start.

items.name: Stickers and craft paper
items.search: kids craft paper stickers art set
items.blurb: Stickers and coloured paper are good stocking fillers and add fun to drawings, cards and collages.
